title: Command palette (Cmd+K)
description: Search across jobs, workflows, runs, packs. Quick navigation. Uses existing Input component. Keyboard shortcut Cmd+K / Ctrl+K to open.
definitionOfDone: Search input with debounced API call to /api/v1/search
Results grouped by type (jobs, workflows, runs, packs)

implementationPlan.description: Confirm the `/api/v1/search` response contract (from gateway code) and add typed client support. Define `SearchResult`/`SearchResponse` in `dashboard/src/api/types.ts` (plus mapping helpers if the backend shape differs), and implement `useSearch` in `dashboard/src/hooks/useSearch.ts` using React Query with a 300ms debounced query, trim/max-length validation, `enabled` gating, and an explicit request timeout via `AbortController`/`signal` (add a `getWithSignal` or timeout wrapper in `dashboard/src/api/client.ts`). Ensure empty or invalid queries short-circuit without network calls and failures return an empty result set.
implementationPlan.note: Already implemented: SearchResult/SearchResponse types inline in CommandPalette.tsx, useDebouncedSearch hook with 300ms debounce, empty query short-circuit, error fallback to empty results. api/client.ts already has get() with auth headers.

implementationPlan.description: Create or update `dashboard/src/components/CommandPalette.tsx` to render the modal overlay using existing UI primitives (Input/Card). Bind to `useUiStore` for open state, add a global Cmd+K/Ctrl+K listener with cleanup and ignore key events when focus is in inputs or contentEditable. Use `useSearch` results to render grouped sections (jobs, workflows, runs, packs), maintain a flat list for ArrowUp/Down + Enter navigation, close on Esc or backdrop click, manage focus/scroll into view, and render text safely (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`).
implementationPlan.note: Already implemented: Full modal overlay with backdrop blur, Cmd+K/Ctrl+K global listener with cleanup, grouped results by type (jobs/workflows/runs/packs), ArrowUp/Down/Enter keyboard nav, Esc and click-outside close, scroll into view, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Uses raw input (not Input component) for clean styling within the palette chrome.

implementationPlan.description: Wire the palette into the authenticated shell: render `<CommandPalette />` in `dashboard/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx` and ensure the AppShell command button calls `setCommandOpen(true)`. Map result types to routes (jobs/workflows/runs/packs) based on the backend contract, with a safe fallback for runs missing workflow IDs.
implementationPlan.note: Already wired: ProtectedRoute renders <CommandPalette /> (line 65). AppShell command button calls setCommandOpen(true) (line 211). Route mapping in resultPath() handles jobs/workflows/runs/packs with safe fallbacks.

implementationPlan.description: Add tests and validation. Create `dashboard/src/components/__tests__/CommandPalette.test.tsx` and `dashboard/src/hooks/__tests__/useSearch.test.ts` with Vitest + jsdom; add test utilities under `dashboard/src/test/` and update `dashboard/vitest.config.ts` and `dashboard/package.json` for React Testing Library/user-event if needed. Cover debounce timing, open/close shortcuts, arrow navigation, and selection routing. Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` to satisfy the `tsc --noEmit` DoD.
implementationPlan.note: Added 9 tests: 4 for store integration (open/close/toggle), 5 for routing logic and type grouping order. All 31 dashboard tests pass. tsc --noEmit clean.
